Kolkata Metro guide for Durga Puja 2026: 8 big pandals within a 20-minute walk of a station 🚇

Chaltabagan, Tala Prattoy, Santosh Mitra Square, Kumartuli Park, Mohammad Ali Park, Shyam Square, FD Block and Behala Notun Dal, each with its station, the walk in minutes and the best time to go. Cabs crawl on Saptami night. The Metro doesn't.

en: Not a cab, the Metro! Which pandal is next to which station: see our new post.

slides.title: Pick one area a night
slides.body: Kolkata is too big for one night. Choose North, South or Central and walk it end to end.

slides.title: Start at the Metro
slides.body: Get off at the area's station and walk. Cabs and autos crawl after 7 pm on Saptami and Ashtami.

slides.title: Go early or very late
slides.body: The big pandals are quietest from about 5 to 9 am. Queues peak from 8 pm to midnight.

slides.title: Comfortable shoes, not new ones
slides.body: A North Kolkata night is 11 km and 16,000 steps.

slides.title: Power bank and some cash
slides.body: Phones die on pujo nights and some stalls only take cash.

slides.title: Fix a meeting point
slides.body: Networks jam in the crowds. Agree where to meet if you get separated.

slides.title: Leave room for food
slides.body: Phuchka, egg roll, Mughlai paratha: plan the stops, not just the pandals.

Durga Puja 2026 pandal hopping checklist: 7 things to sort before Shashthi ✅

Pick one area a night, start at the Metro, go early or very late, wear shoes you've already walked in, carry a power bank and some cash, fix a meeting point, and plan the food stops. Pujo runs 17 to 21 October.
